text: APPROVE. Extracting the nested match check into `MatchesRequestedVersion` removes a nested `if` and a `&&` from `Parse`, which should drop its complexity from 17 to 15 or below. Behaviour looks preserved: a mismatch still hits `continue`, a match falls through to what appears to be the same `ReadVersion` return, and the unchanged no-version path is the same. The helper is a plain static method, so I expect no new warnings. I could not see the few lines between the two hunks, or build the project, so the fall-through equivalence and the build are inferred from the diff, not verified.
